title_zh: 马栏山音视频装备产业园正式开园 陈竞陈博彰为园区揭牌并见证签约
title_en: Malanshan Audio-Video Equipment Industrial Park Officially Opens; Chen Jing and Chen Bozhang Attend Unveiling and Signing
summary_zh: 8月20日，马栏山音视频装备产业园正式开园，陈竞、陈博彰为园区揭牌并见证项目签约。
summary_en: On August 20, the Malanshan Audio-Video Equipment Industrial Park officially opened, with Chen Jing and Chen Bozhang unveiling the plaque and witnessing contract signings.
